Operator confirms the original acceptance on installed disposable target.
Protected publisher status handler publishes transactional catalog invalidation events, hides active publisher games and keeps immutable releases.
Operator confirms the original acceptance on installed disposable target.
Validated after/limit cursor contracts prevent unbounded client pages and preserve reviewed-only projections.
Operator confirms the original acceptance on installed disposable target.

Windows ZipRunner adopts refreshed recipe and runs full regression tests in .venv, not the host Python.
Windows checkout hash portability and pinned DAPI panel CSS build sequence are enforced by source regression checks.
Official GitHub Actions and ZipRunner target acceptance remains independent of source checks.

checks.description: Source regression against bundled test
assertions: Security and positive source behavior are covered by this test implementation.

checks.description: Target observable confirmation
checks.instructions: From a disposable database approve a game, supply its reviewed hash-named HTML and export to a public static test origin; no API credentials in browser. Corrupt asset, tamper release and confirm no new snapshot replaces the last valid bytes; verify a disabled publisher disappears after next export.

checks.description: Source regression against bundled test
assertions: Security and positive source behavior are covered by this test implementation.

checks.description: Target observable confirmation
checks.instructions: With apps:approve change active publisher to disabled; check existing releases remain and new catalog hides apps. Confirm wrong/missing scope fails and reactivation restores only still-published apps.

checks.description: Source regression against bundled test
assertions: Security and positive source behavior are covered by this test implementation.

checks.description: Target observable confirmation
checks.instructions: Request catalog with apps:read, page limit 1, follow next until hasMore false; malformed after and limit return 422.

checks.description: Bootstrapping order, isolation and repeat-build regression
assertions: Windows and POSIX dependency-bridge tests expect native Path string representations, not POSIX-only literal mock paths.
The direct legacy Python test path executes actual SQLAlchemy and Starlette registry tests.
Both importable .zr recipes use the isolated build environment and protect .venv from the ZIP overlay.

checks.description: Windows target ZipRunner verification
checks.instructions: Import v0.4.8 using existing atrium project. Confirm 88 Python tests pass on Windows, including catalog/registry integration tests, without path separator failures. Confirm build succeeds before marking operator review complete.

checks.description: Static test of DAPI CI prerequisites and LF policy
assertions: Pinned DAPI Node 24 Sass compilation happens after checkout and before smoke.
looprd.yaml line endings are LF and the link SHA matches raw bytes.
New source ZIP includes .gitattributes and release CI uses 0.4.8.

checks.description: CI and Windows acceptance on actual targets
checks.instructions: Push to the authorized Atrium repository, rerun GitHub Actions: confirm Windows Python and YAML hash pass; verify pinned DAPI CSS compilation and live disposable smoke; verify official ZipRunner source ZIP validator, then import v0.4.8 in Windows ZipRunner.

checks.description: Source-backed architecture contract regression
assertions: Tavi remains chat; Atrium launches games; Social owns user registration; Pages is static; platform compatibility and install modes are scoped as future work.

checks.description: Review the approved documentation direction
checks.instructions: Verify Social account registration is shared, Tavi is chat only with Atrium launch, Atrium is Pages+Looprd, and platform-aware installation remains planned rather than claimed working.

checks.description: GitHub Pages handoff and publishing boundary test
assertions: Pages workflow only runs on workflow_dispatch and runs checks before deployment.
Static web path is subpath-safe and includes no operator credentials or fake authentication.
Registry database schema stays 2; .nojekyll enters source archive and build output.

checks.description: Independent hosted Pages acceptance
checks.instructions: After an approved Git commit and manual dispatch, confirm Pages hosts /<repo>/ with relative imports; empty catalog remains empty, and verified published games load only from reviewed immutable origins. No client Social/operator credential is present.

checks.description: Source contract/doc separation tests
assertions: Existing v1 schema rejects v2 fields.
Life v2 example is non-executable, uses existing Life component and platform-safe install:none.
Asciidoc explicitly states operator registration and larger hosted game follow-up.

checks.description: Review external hosted Life launch plan and source/runtime boundary
checks.instructions: Inspect Life web build origin, snapshot/export operator process, verify no v2 API, Social login or native install exists in current Atrium. Confirm proposed session and SDK calls never send Social bearer tokens to Life.

checks.description: Source-only Looprd discovery design regression
assertions: Discovery uses existing Looprd handler fields, not unknown root metadata.
Atrium runtime/API is unchanged; no registration endpoint is misrepresented as implemented.
Document game-owned session/identity and separate trusted deployment/publisher announcement.

checks.description: Operator-scoped discovery candidate idempotence and validation tests
assertions: New candidate is pending and never enters AppRelease or the public catalog.
Same source revision and document are idempotent; changed revision triggers review.
Publisher takeover, URLs, bad component IDs and privileged game session claims are rejected.
Deployer CLI sends an operator-key protected HTTPS request without redirect forwarding.

checks.description: Live DAPI schema v3 migration and operator candidate intake
checks.instructions: Back up real Atrium DB. Validate schema v2→v3 on restored disposable environment. After Life activation, run deployer CLI with a private approved component key; verify candidate GET is operator-only, public catalog unchanged, and game sessions continue independently.

checks.description: Verify manifest, workboard and verification plan task/check coverage
assertions: Every delivered implemented workboard ID has exactly one verification plan task; remaining tasks are not delivered.
All criteria reference declared checks of the expected kind, and automated tests exist in package.
ATR-108-LOOPRD-DISCOVERY remains planned, with valid todo status and next action.

checks.description: Operator review of exact GitHub CI and installed ZIP
checks.instructions: Review v0.5.11 exact pushed commit; confirm both GitHub jobs and official pinned ZipRunner 2.3 validator pass. Run fresh post-update tests against installed ZIP bytes, and keep tickets in review until operator acceptance.

checks.description: Publisher proof source failure-path and positive test suite
assertions: Origin challenge is single-use, time-limited and bound to publisher and registered HTTPS origin.
All DNS answers must be globally routable; TLS connection pins validated IP, refuses redirects and oversized content.
Proof alone never changes active publisher approval, public catalog or Social identity.

checks.description: Live operator acceptance of independent publisher HTTPS domain proof
checks.instructions: Backup production DB; test v3→v4 migration on disposable instance. Register a controlled public DNS hostname, issue via apps:approve, host returned proofContent as UTF-8 at proofUrl, verify, then attempt reuse, redirect, bad TLS, private DNS, disabled publisher and wrong origin. Ensure immutable releases/catalog unchanged. Do not mark Done or release without operator review.

checks.description: Live HTTP gateway no stale data, revocation, CORS and 503 regression suite
assertions: GET always revalidates approved SQLite and asset data
Publisher disable removes app next request without redeploy
Missing DB and hash tampering fail closed with 503/no-store
Only operator-configured browser origin receives CORS headers; no admin keys

checks.description: Public Pages HTTPS catalog configuration and revoked release enforcement tests
assertions: Public config rejects credentialed/unsafe URLs
No-store anonymous fetch, release identity matching, fallback only when explicitly unconfigured
Frontend rechecks before mounting and removes revoked iframe

checks.description: Real HTTPS gateway, Pages activation and revocation acceptance
checks.instructions: Back up/replay schema-v4 SQLite on disposable DAPI; start read-only loopback gateway behind operator TLS proxy with cache disabled, manually dispatch Pages workflow with reviewed clean public catalog URL. Publish reviewed asset and verify anonymous Pages display. Disable publisher, ensure next gateway request omits game and client closes iframe by next foreground/60-second refresh; corrupt asset/stop DB and verify 503 with no cached fallback. Check no API secret/client auth, strict CORS and proxy behavior. Verify exact-commit CI and matching installed ZipRunner post-update checks; do not approve release or mark Done without operator approval.

checks.description: American checkers moves, jumps, promotion, deterministic Staff and unprivileged UI
assertions: Initial seven moves and deterministic Staff baseline
Mandatory complete captures and crown terminates capture chain
No browser credential/network parent bridge in standalone demo

checks.description: Manual Pages staging yields SHA-256 immutable and valid browser catalog entry; refuses live-gateway mixing
assertions: Staged HTML digest equals catalog manifest sha256 and URL path
Static preview starts empty until opted into workflow_dispatch
Configured live gateway refuses a static demo override

checks.description: Reviewed manual Pages publication, browser play and rollback
checks.instructions: After v0.5.14 CI and operator source review, dispatch Publish reviewed Atrium Pages with publish_checkers_demo=true and catalog_url empty. Verify a real browser Play action, forced captures, New game, two-person and Staff mode, mobile display and no privileged tokens. Roll back with publish_checkers_demo=false and verify the game disappears. Do not mark Done without operator approval and installed-ZIP post-update acceptance.
